summary: Calculates and visualizes trial-averaged firing rate profiles for neuronal populations, segmented by stimulus difficulty and behavioral choice.
use_when: How do I compute trial-averaged firing rates for my neural data?
Show me how to plot PSTHs grouped by task condition
Generate population firing rate profiles sorted by stimulus difficulty and choice
How can I visualize trial-aligned neural activity for decision-making tasks?
Help me construct PSTHs for simultaneously recorded neurons
avoid_when: Neural and behavioral measurements cannot be aligned on a common time base
